asked.item: switch existing automation to main account
set up automation on main account

verdict.reason: The sentences state that the connected account is locked after a flow is created and that a different account requires a new flow, which answers whether the existing flow can be switched.

steps.text: No, you can't switch this flow to another account, because the connected account is locked once the flow is created.
To use a different account, create a new flow.
When you create the new flow, pick the connected Instagram account or Facebook Page it should run on.
Click New automation, name the flow, then click Create flow.
